posts.title: The World Athletics Photograph of the Year shortlist
posts.description: World Athletics has made available the digital exhibition featuring the 10 best photographs, among which are the three finalists vying for the title, to be announced on the 28th. As I often say when it comes to photography, I rarely agree with World Athletics’ choices. And this year is no different. posts.title: The 2026 Rising Stars: my choice
posts.description: I do not know precisely what criteria World Athletics uses for its Rising Stars category. In any case, I am sure they are not the same as mine. For me, anybody under 23 years of age is eligible.
